Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Community Broadband Bits 6 - Cheryl Leanza of Progressive States Network By Christopher Mitchell on Jul 31, 2012 Our sixth episode of the Community Broadband Bits podcast features a discussion with Cheryl Leanza, broadband consultant with Progressive States Network . Cheryl has been very active in legislative battles at the state level, where she has helped to defend the public against anti-consumer deregulation led by AT&T, CenturyLink, and cable lobbyists. We touched on the effort in Georgia to revoke local authority as well as once again noting the bad bills in North Carolina in 2011 and South Carolina in 2012 . We also spent time talking about the state-by-state effort to kill consumer protections , including the basic right to have a wireline telephone in your home.
